notes.content:
EPIC UPDATE

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
BIG UPDATE
I'm back with a BIG update, and this time i'm taking it literally! The short boost "Super Size" doubles you in size, and makes you do twice the damage! I'm sure a lot of you will also enjoy the newly added - Aim Assist - feature for controllers. You can adjust the Aim Assist strength, or turn it off, in the options menu.

Come check out the new features and let me know what else you would like to see implemented!

New short boost: Super Size
 Added: Short Boost "Super Size". Double the size, twice the damage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/8eb63fc96ff383cfcae374f1543dcbdc35a842ac.gif

New: Aim Assist
 Added: Aim assist for controllers. You can adjust the strength, or turn it off, in the options menu. When the target is within range, the aim assist will help aim towards the target.

New: Hitstop effect
 Added: Hitstop effect for the following attacks:

 No weapon: Normal attack (80ms)
 Melee weapons: Knife (90ms) and Laser Sword (110ms)
 Normal weapons: Sniper and Shotgun (both 50ms) and Rocket explosion (150ms)
 Ultra weapons: Singularis and Pulsorion (both 10ms per frame the bullet hits, duration does not stack)

Info: Hitstop adds a very short pauze to the movement of a target, and sometimes also attacker, when getting hit. This increases the impact's feel. The effect is very short, so it should not impact the overall gameplay experience.

Other changes
 Added: Resources preloader. This will reduce lag spikes when certain resources are created
 Added: 3 new background music tracks

 Updated: Accuracy upgrade normal tier to 50%, epic tier to 100%
 Updated: When pressing down direction mid-air you go down faster
 Updated: Amount of weapons spawned for Short Boost reduced to 4~6
 Updated: Players are now not able to change direction during a melee attack
 Updated: Bots navigation when holding Ultra Weapon Singularis
 Updated: Less chance for Pro bots to dash when holding melee weapons
 Updated: Camera shake for all weapons. Also, more camera shake when less players are joined
 Updated: Melee weapon Laser Sword attack soundfx

 Fixed: Punch animation not finished causing weapon rotation issues
 Fixed: Laser Sword beam was visible for a frame when it spawned
 Fixed: Winner crown, environment and background color did not change in rare occasions
 Fixed: Mouse visibility for certain scenarios

I'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
BIG UPDATE
We're back with a big update! Stock Mode is added for MF'ers that prefer to play without time. We also made many new custom accessories and added tons of languages!

New game mode
Stock mode lets you play with lives instead of time. This way you can play more strategic without having to deal with time. Survive the longest to win the round. The amount of stocks is configurable in the Game Options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/0d5ef43f518de804f2a7e0c4863823a64aea21b7.jpg

New accessories
We added 15 custom made accessories! They are now also pixel perfect, to the character, and animated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/1b6963b7539b27d89cf7658c1a667cfd63cb75a6.jpg

New languages
The following languages are now present in Miami Fighters

 English
 Dutch
 Simplified Chinese
 French
 Italian
 German
 Serbian
 Spanish
 Japanese
 Russian
 Portugese
If you find a translation that is incorrect, please let us know in the Community Hub.

Other changes

 Added: Disclaimer seizure warning and updated font size for readability
 Added: Apply random accessory for players in demo mode (don't touch any key for 15 seconds in the Main Menu screen to activate demo mode)
 Fixed: First press on controller or ESC button didn't do anything in player selection
 Fixed: Team mode sub score alignment for 5 and 15 matches

Please visit the Community Hub if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Happy new year!
First off we want to thank you guys for supporting the game. We hope you've been enjoying it thus far, I know I have. Next year we'll be bashing out updates for you, so stay tuned!
We wish you all a happy 2025.

Changes

 Added: More platform types

 Elevator platform
 Sinking platform
 Conveyor platform
 Vanishing and reappearing platform
 Updated: Most maps to make use of the new platform types
 Updated: The first weapons that spawn per round are now all the same. 
This increases the fairness of the game.

 Fixed: Bullet doesn't ricochet on platforms moving towards incoming bullet

Please visit the Community Hub if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/bd4c84c9e41dc2d271a3e28c2a99387ae0723625.jpg
Changes

 Added: Toggle for controller vibration in options menu
 Added: Vignette flashing in the color of the winning player for the last couple seconds of a match
 Added: Take consecutive losses into account when getting upgrades

 The higher the player is ranked (1st place being the highest), and the more consecutive losses a player has, the higher probability he gets for a better upgrade
This eliminates the "losing on purpose in the beginning" to get ahead with better upgrades

 Changed: Greatly reduced default knockback for all base weapons
 Changed: Upgrades now have rounded numbers. Example: +33.4% is now +33%, and +33.6% is now +34%
 Updated: Darker vignette when the match is almost over
 Updated: Clearer text in Scoreboard view
 Updated: Most solid platforms now have full surrounding neon

 Fixed: Starting the match didn't work properly on some devices
 Fixed: Custom font not working on non-Windows devices
 Fixed: When audio is 0 on Master bus and MF is restarted, the audio does not get set 0

Please visit the Community Hub if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the first update since the release! Full of bug fixes and optimizations. we want everyone to enjoy Miami Fighters, so we added a solid implementation for localization. Adding more languages in the future will now be a lot easier.

Release notes v0.1.9

 Added: Localization (English and Dutch for now, other languages will follow soon)
 Optimized: Weapon rotation (faster)
 Optimized: Lowered dead zone for aim override
 Fixed: Team mode individual player scores not being reset to 0 on round start
 Fixed: Closing options using the shortcut not working in pauze mode
 Fixed: Main Menu button not working in first second of match
 Fixed: If W is pressed, player is unable to jump with Space, and vice versa
 Changed: Mouse visibility to only where mouse is needed
 Changed: Functionality to start a match
 Updated: Many texts and controller layout view

Please visit the Community Hub if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!
